notes.title: May Update
notes.notes: This month we have added the Aliens!! special card. Make sure to watch out for their powerful laser.

notes.title: Game Breaking Bug Fixed
notes.notes: The bug preventing the game from being launched has been fixed. Please resume your normal chucking behavior.

notes.title: Game Breaking Bug Warning
notes.notes:
It's come to our attention that there is a bug preventing the game from being launched. It is affecting both Mac and Windows versions. We are working to fix the issue and apologize for any inconvenience. 

If the game starts when you play it awesome but if the bug pops up for and and you know anything more about it, add it to the discussion panel for us.

notes.title: Adding the Smoke Screen
notes.notes: This month, we added the Smoke Screen, an ability which lets you disappear into a cloud of smoke. Find it now

notes.title: March Monthly Update
notes.notes: Add the Rune throwable to the game. This Throwable increases in power after each foe it hits.
